title: Dense local-attention reference correctness
status: fixed-weight correctness and bounded-cache gates passed; no training run
hypothesis: A dense boolean causal-window mask can implement the declared local dependency semantics, preserve full/chunk/cache gradients, and bound retained key/value state to at most window_size - 1 prior tokens.

change.window_semantics: q - window_size + 1 <= key_position <= q, using absolute positions
change.cache_policy: retain a contiguous copy of the final min(window_size - 1, processed_tokens) key/value entries between calls
change.compute_estimator: decoder-module-mac-v1, priced identically to dense full attention

control: CausalSelfAttention with identical weights where the local window covers the input, plus an independent slow per-query-slice oracle for local outputs and gradients.

correctness_coverage: sequence lengths W - 1, W, W + 1 and 2W + 1
odd chunk partitions and a first chunk exactly one full window long
full and cached chunk output parity
full and cached chunk input/parameter gradient parity
slow per-query-slice oracle for MQA, GQA and MHA head layouts
RoPE and learned positions; RMSNorm and LayerNorm; pre-norm and post-norm residuals
module-specific window validation and dense cost/state descriptors
evaluation.cache_state_shape_for_byte_cases: 2 local layers, batch 2, 2 KV heads, head_dim 8, float32

result: All declared fixed-weight, gradient, causal-mask, position, option, cache-bound and storage-byte assertions passed. The local estimator reports the same dense compute as full attention at the same model shape/context. No latency, prefill-work reduction, training stability, or capability metric was measured.
interpretation: The reference implements bounded local semantics and exact retained KV storage on CPU. It still executes dense attention operands; the result establishes correctness and state behavior only.
limitations: No CUDA correctness or resource validation was possible on this CPU-only PyTorch build.
No training or learning fixture was run.
The reference does not provide sparse prefill compute or a speed claim.
The independent M2-GQA-002 three-seed comparison rerun remains open as a separate evidence item.
next_gate: S04 may proceed only with a preregistered bounded local pilot against a fresh same-revision conventional GQA control, the frozen Q10/Q11 protocol, and complete planned resource accounting.
